text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While having a meeting with Sakura Laurel
in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My head is throbbing a little...
Trainer-san, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Laurel pulled a cooling sheet out of her school bag and placed it on her forehead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while later, Sakura Laurel
peeled the cooling sheet from her forehead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I'm feeling much better.
Now I can focus on the meeting.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch. It might be flaring up again...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed the root cause of the pain hadn't been resolved.
For a while, Sakura Laurel continued to suffer from headaches.
